classes_note: Three classes, each the census's own kind, area, evidence kind or relation for the entity, stated by field sources at the loci given: (1) anti-revisionist movements, organizations and parties, EROL's subject (census kind, record.keeps; B1, B2, B4); (2) archives of movement and party documents, the census area 'movement-documents' with its 'record of splits', and EROL's evidence kinds (census areas, evidence_kind; B1, B4, B5); (3) sections of the Marxists Internet Archive, by the census's part_of relation (B3, B4, B8). The aliases are the entity's name (both capitalizations, 'Anti-Revisionism' and 'anti-Revisionism'), its abbreviation EROL (case-sensitive) and its path on marxists.org. The Marxists Internet Archive is EROL's host and a distinct entity with its own census record and /non row (marxists-internet-archive); a sentence of the archive that names it enters only where it says something of the archive's sections, its holding or its terms, and a marxists.org URL given as the source of a quoted text is a reference line, not a claim. #1725, the census's anchor, is read at the passages that name the entity or its kind (archives of the left, organs, holders, splits). Admission by reading (§3.4): D where a deposit names the entity and says something of it; O-class where a sentence applies an archive category (the organ, the holder and the route of a losing position; the ending of a dispute; embrittlement; Marx as identity) to one of the three classes; a bare mention, a URL given as a source, a reference line or a list of keywords is not a claim.
